content.markdown: Optional display kind. A resolved Macro without a kind defaults to `const`, not `fvar`; a true Macro miss can fall back to `fvar`. Explicit node semantic kinds are preserved, while Macro `sub` is structurally transparent. Non-special custom kinds retain their display identity and use const behavior. See `resolveRenderedKind` and `behaviorKind` in `src/snl-react-view/kind-behavior.ts`.
